title: Article 32 — Remedies for enforcement of fundamental rights

content.heading: Remedies for enforcement of rights conferred by this Part
content.text: The right to move the Supreme Court by appropriate proceedings for the enforcement of the rights conferred by this Part is guaranteed. The Supreme Court may issue directions, orders or writs including habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, quo warranto and certiorari. The right shall not be suspended except as otherwise provided by the Constitution.
